_notes.noindex: true while this is a test build. Run `python3 tools/set-indexing.py index` at launch.
_notes.api_base: URL of the Cloudflare Worker, e.g. https://api.yogamaty.com. Empty = forms show a 'not live yet' message.
_notes.turnstile_site_key: Cloudflare Turnstile PUBLIC site key. Empty = widget omitted (the Worker will then reject unless TURNSTILE_SECRET is also unset).
_notes.stripe_payment_link: The Stripe Payment Link URL (https://buy.stripe.com/...). Empty = the buy button shows a disabled 'opens at launch' state.
_notes.whitepaper_url: Path or URL of the whitepaper PDF, e.g. /assets/docs/transparatrade-whitepaper.pdf. Empty = 'coming shortly' state.
_notes.price: Retail price in USD, e.g. "48.00". Empty = shows an [ADD RETAIL PRICE] placeholder and no price in structured data.
_notes.batch: Current production batch: label (e.g. "2026-04"), capacity (~50), taken (number of places taken; null = placeholder). When taken >= capacity the page shows "This batch is full".
_notes.sold_out: Flip to true to force the "this batch is full" state (also set the quantity limit on the Stripe Payment Link).
